item.title: Captures: public writes (new topic, poll vote, moderator alert, topic delete, rehost upload)
item.body:
Closes #275
Closes #265
Closes #136
Closes #135
Refs #138 (left: a reply refused because the topic is locked, a ban refusal)
Refs #137 (left: the logged-out vote answer, held for an operator decision, see below)
Closes #302
Claim: mac/capture-batch

Capture work (run 8 of the LOT-001 kit), not a lot. Public writes approved by the operator on #337 (2026-11-02).

**Problem.** LOT-048, LOT-037, LOT-050, LOT-054 and LOT-056 had no real answer for a new topic (E14), a first-post delete, a poll vote, a moderator alert and an image-host upload, so they report these writes as `unconfirmed` or rely on legacy code only.

**What was sent** (27 HFR requests, 2 image-host requests, one attempt per state, 2026-11-02 ~05:35-05:50 UTC):
- user1 created one throwaway topic `fixture-test` in Programmation › iOS (`W40`), added a two-answer poll by editing its first post (`W41`), voted (`W42`) and voted again (`W43`); user2 sent the same vote (`W44`).
- user2 reported the topic's first post to the moderators with a text saying it is a test of the app's developers, to be ignored (`W46`), and reopened the alert page (`R88`); the alert page and POST were also sent without cookies (`W47`, `R89`).
- user1 deleted the first post: the whole topic is gone, its URL answers 404 (`W49`, `R92`). Nothing of the run is left on HFR (the moderators received the test alert).
- `img3.super-h.fr`: one 16×16 grey JPEG uploaded with the legacy key (`U01`, still online: the answer's `delete_url` needs a browser session) and one with a wrong key (`U02`).
- Not sent: a reply to a locked topic (not an operator topic), a ban refusal (no banned account).

**What changed.**
- 14 captures with metas (`MANIFEST.md` run 8), `corpus.json` rows.
- `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md`: E14 settled; LOT-037 subsection (alert and vote answers); LOT-048 (new topic, poll added by the first-post edit form, first-post delete deletes the topic); LOT-026 / E10 (vote POST); LOT-056 (upload and answer **verified**, B12).
- `publish.py`: a `.hop` answer rarely names its topic, so the own topic is also taken from the request (URL, body, and `numeropost=`, the vote body's topic field); without it the real topic id stayed in the metas of `W43`-`W49` and publish refused them. Test `test_own_topic_named_only_by_the_request_is_aliased_in_the_meta` fails without the change.
- `HopResponseParserTests` sweep: `W40`, `W41`, `W49` join the write confirmations. `W42` (no "avec succès") and `W46` (back link, no refresh) do **not** classify as success today: follow-up issue for LOT-037/050/054.

**Held, not published (operator decision needed).** `W45`, the vote body sent without cookies on a poll that does not allow visitors, and `R86`, the results afterwards. Their content is a weakness of HFR itself, so it is not described here; details went to the operator through the session report.

**Checks.** `anonymize.py check --corpus` (all files clean) and `check --config` on the 28 new files: clean. Independent leak check by a separate Sonnet agent from the raw files: **CLEAN** (28 files; pseudos, member ids, tokens, cookies, own topic and message ids, image-host delete fields). No legacy oracle: the new pages are `.hop` answers (no legacy parser output; `HopResponseParserTests` reads the captures) and `R83` repeats `R32b`'s vote form. `swift test` (HFRKit) green locally; `python3 -m unittest discover tooling/fixtures/tests` green.

** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Include request message IDs in the batch-wide alias table.** `own_message_ids` collects IDs only from pages.
